summary: File the habitual past example under Detransitive Infectum-wa
rationale: The target verb mǝšrodiwa is the plural Infectum with -wa, corresponding to the entry's Infectum base mǝšrǝd. It is not the Preterit šrīd/šridi. Di naqla 'each time' and the supplied habitual-past translation agree with Infectum-wa.
